statuses: A chapter's first status: an idea only.
Planned in the outline, not yet drafted.
seeds.untitled-chapter: Title of a new chapter whose name the writer left empty. Written into the book as its title and file name.
seeds.untitled-part: Title of a new part whose name the writer left empty. Written into the book.
seeds.unnamed-character: Title of a new character whose name was left empty. Written into the book.
seeds.unnamed-location: Title of a new location whose name was left empty. Written into the book.
seeds.untitled-note: Title of a new note whose name was left empty. Written into the book.
seeds.untitled-outline: Title of a new outline whose name was left empty. Written into the book.
seeds.heading-description: Heading a new character or location starts with (as `## Description`). Written into the book; writers may change it.
seeds.heading-history: Heading a new character or location starts with. Written into the book.
seeds.heading-arc: Heading a new character starts with: the character's development over the story. Written into the book.
seeds.comment-defaults: YAML comment at the top of a new novel.md. Keep 'Plot Device' as is.
seeds.comment-language: YAML comment beside `language:` in a new novel.md.
seeds.comment-calendar: YAML comment beside `calendar:`. Keep the values gregorian and day-count and the date example as they are.
seeds.comment-threads: YAML comment beside `threads: []`, followed by a commented example.
seeds.comment-thread-name: Name of the example thread in the commented example in a new novel.md.
seeds.comment-file-names: YAML comment beside `file_names:`. Keep the values ask, always and never as they are.
seeds.comment-order-prefix: YAML comment beside `order_prefix:`. Keep `true` as is.
seeds.comment-template: YAML comment beside the template folder setting.

recognized.outline_inbox: The `##` heading in an outline that captured beats go under; the app finds it by this word. Short and plain; writers can override it in novel.md.
